static_write_path.hash_only_B: Each array occurrence is copied and hashed, then its descriptor is appended to the array index with flush/fsync. No raster blob is stored.
static_write_path.full_capture_C: The same copy, hash and index append occur; each array additionally writes a raw blob, fsyncs it and publishes a hardlink before the index append.
static_write_path.note: Static call-path difference only. It does not quantify time or establish root cause.

limits: Pending C index and blocks are incomplete; the verified block prefix is not the total executed event count.
A linear projection is not a safe deadline or proof of completion time.
Target CPU contention, filesystem latency, array write, hashing and fsync costs were not separately measured.
B validated alone does not establish B/C semantic match.
recommended_next_evidence: A separately reviewed synthetic-only target microprofile that isolates event encoding from Full Capture array publication and measures write/fsync/hash time; no change to Codec, event content or formal science thresholds.
